prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Browse through our pet breeds and see how they move on your screen.", "Select Pet Breed"]
1: ["Quick Desktop Controls", "Learn how to interact with your pet in seconds.", "Drag pet to move | Right-click to hide | Double-click to talk"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Home...", "We are getting your desktop ready. Your pet will spawn shortly!", "Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on screen after it appears."]
3: ["How Would You Like to Get Your Pet?", "Choose between adopting an instant pet breed or creating a custom pet from your own photos.", "Instant Adopt vs Custom Creation"]
4: ["Signing in links your pet to your account so your companion is safe across devices.", "Sign in to secure your pet profile and save progress automatically."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Congratulations! Your new pet companion is ready to join your desktop.", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "Say hello! Click and drag your companion to test their movements now.", "Start Exploring"]
7: ["A Cute Companion Right on Your Screen", "Bring your desktop to life with a friendly companion that keeps you company while you work or play.", "Meet My Pet"]
8: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward.", "Good lighting ensures your pet's custom model turns out great!", "Well lit | Clear face visible | No heavy filters"]
9: ["Loading taking too long? Check connection or try clicking retry.", "Connecting to account server..."]
